824558049.accepts_evidence: Annual open cycle: nonprofits submit one letter of intent through the Impact 100 proposal portal; committees then invite about five semifinalists per focus area to send full proposals, followed by site visits and a member vote. https://www.impact100pbc.org/grant_process.php
824558049.conflicts_with_return: None noted (return has no application details).
824558049.contact: Impact 100 Palm Beach County, 261 NW 13th Street, Boca Raton, FL 33432; impact100pbc@gmail.com; 561-336-4623.
824558049.deadlines: 2026-27 cycle: grant training August 26, 2026; portal opened August 26, 2026; LOI due September 24, 2026 by 5:00 p.m.; semifinalists announced December 11, 2026; full proposal due January 14, 2027 by 5:00 p.m.; site visits January-February 2027; finalists early April 2027; member vote at the April awards event; contracts and first payment late May.
824558049.eligibility: 501(c)(3) for the three years before the LOI deadline (September 24, 2026 for the 2026-27 cycle); the FAQ also asks for registration with the Florida Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services. One LOI per organization, in one focus area. Project must be high-impact and transformative (new, an expansion, or a collaboration) with measurable outcomes; letters of support from partners. Past $100,000 recipients wait three grant cycles; merit award winners may reapply the next year.
824558049.geographic_limits: Southern Palm Beach County only: Lake Worth Road south to the Broward County line, Atlantic Ocean west to the county line. The full grant must be spent there within 24 months.
824558049.grant_range_stated: $100,000 per grant, paid in two $50,000 installments; finalists not chosen share the remaining funds as merit awards (amount varies).
824558049.how_to_apply: Attend the August grant training (recommended), then submit one LOI with the IRS determination letter in the Impact 100 proposal portal by the September deadline; full proposal only if invited as a semifinalist.
824558049.name: Impact 100 Palm Beach County
824558049.not_funded: Projects under $100,000; more than one project; work outside the focus areas or the geographic area; general operating support or unrelated overhead; debt, deficits, loans, bridge funding; fundraising campaigns or events; endowments or memorials; partisan or political activity; sectarian projects promoting religion; legal expenses; unrelated travel; grants to individuals or private foundations; planning, fundraising or marketing for a capital campaign.
824558049.notes: Public charity (women's collective giving); all grants are competitive, none donor-advised. The 2026-27 LOI deadline has passed; next cycle should open around late August 2027. Applicant must serve southern Palm Beach County and need a $100,000 project. Site reports 137 grants totaling $8.5 million over 15 years. Portal address is not printed on the pages read.
824558049.page_dated: Grant process and eligibility pages show the 2026-27 cycle; FAQ still shows the prior cycle's LOI date (October 23, 2025); footer copyright 2026.
824558049.types_of_support: Single project grants. Capital campaign requests are eligible if the use of funds is itemized, no funds go to marketing or fundraising, and the project finishes within two years.
